scientific_integrity: The classical qualitative zero-one law and pp-elimination are credited as prior work. The executable checks are finite evidence, not proof of the universal asymptotic statement.
scientific_limitations: Fixed prime; uniform isomorphism-class sampling; not uniform labelled operations. Historical priority of quantitative speed refinement not independently established; elimination may be computationally costly.
title: Quantized half-power convergence rates for first-order properties of random finite abelian \(p\)-groups
